title: Vego Sausage Subs
subtitle: with Grilled Capsicum and Onion Relish
description: Calling all vegetarians and flexitarians. Now you can have your sausage subs and eat them too! They look like sausages but are completely meat free. Pile into buns with grilled capsicum and a delicious caramelised onion relish.

steps.text: Grill capsicum: Preheat the grill to high. Line an oven tray with foil. Thinly slice the onion. Cut the capsicum into 3cm-thick strips and put on the lined tray. Drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Turn all the capsicum strips so they are skin side up, then grill for 13-15 mins until the skin begins to blacken.
Start onion relish: Meanwhile, heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium frypan over medium heat. Cook the onion and half the mint and rosemary seasoning, stirring, for 5 mins or until softened.

Pan-fry sausages: While the onion is cooking, heat 2 tsp olive oil in a separate medium frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the sausages (see Kitchen 101), turning regularly, for 6 mins or until golden and cooked through. Remove the pan from the heat.

Finish onion relish: Add 1 tbs tomato paste, 1 tbs red wine vinegar, 1 tbs sugar and 2 tbs water to the onion. Reduce the heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 3 mins or until thickened and slightly sticky. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Serve up: Cut the bread rolls in half lengthwise, but not all the way through. Spread the rolls with 2 tbs mayonnaise, if using, then fill with the spinach, grilled capsicum, sausages and onion relish. If you like, cut each roll in half and wrap in strips of baking paper or tie with string to secure. Enjoy!

Kitchen 101: The sausages have a fragile plant-based skin, so take care when cooking and turning them in the pan. Keep the sausages a little apart when cooking, as they can stick together if touching.
